name: gemma-4-26b-a4b-vllm-think4k
notes: Gemma 4 thinking (model card + chat_template.jinja, 2026-10-12): '<|think|>' in the system turn turns thinking on; the reply is '<|channel>thought\n...<channel|>answer'. Both markers are SPECIAL tokens, so the request must set skip_special_tokens=false or vLLM deletes them (the preflight aborts on a tag-free reply). Thinking capped at 4,096 tokens (vLLM thinking_token_budget; server --reasoning-config with reasoning_start_str '<|channel>thought' and a wrap-up phrase + '<channel|>' as reasoning_end_str; no top-level --reasoning-parser) + 1,024 answer tokens (owner 2026-10-12). Sampling per the model card: --temperature 1.0 --top-p 0.95, top_k 64, fixed seed. RTX PRO 6000 96GB (owner).
